items.question: What is the insurance premium in AED for a domestic worker policy under the UAE worker insurance scheme for workers and domestic workers?
items.fact: Domestic worker insurance premium is AED 105 per certificate

items.question: What is the maximum insurance coverage per worker if a company goes bankrupt under the UAE MoHRE worker insurance scheme?
items.gold: A maximum of AED 20,000 per worker.
items.fact: Maximum insurance coverage per worker is AED 20,000
